flows:
Navigate to https://earth.nullschool.net/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
Use Tab to reach the control labeled earth at the lower left of the globe.
Press Enter, then verify that the settings menu is expanded and displays its Mode and Projection controls.

remark: press_key: PRIMARY: press the Tab key
press_key: PRIMARY: press the Enter key
analyze: the settings menu displays its Projection control
assert: the settings menu is expanded and displays its Mode and Projection controls

summary:
The requested lower-left globe control labeled “earth” was reached using the keyboard and activated.
The settings menu opened successfully and displayed both the Mode and Projection controls.
The task was completed on the public Earth Nullschool site without entering sign-in, registration, or payment screens.
